name: Spindrift
description: Fine streaks of snow blown low along the ground in gusts, rising and dipping together like a veil.

props.name: strength
props.description: Wind strength from 0 to 1. Stronger wind races faster, lifts the veil higher and carries more snow.

props.name: direction
props.description: Where the wind blows, in degrees on screen: 0 to the right, 180 to the left. Negative angles lift the veil a little, positive ones press it down.

props.name: gusts
props.description: Let gusts come and go, travelling across the frame with the wind. Off, the wind holds nearly steady.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the snow. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered above the snow. Moving the pointer across it leans the wind toward the movement for a few seconds.
